text.zh_CN:
虽然名字里有“原始”，它却能将复合源质完整分解为组成它的所有原始要素。右键打开界面，放入材料和燃料，就能炼化物品并分解要素。
也可以从底部通过管道或源质容器输入源质，这种输入不消耗燃料。将奥术蒸馏器叠在炉子上方，从蒸馏器引出管道；最多可叠放五个。
原始要素会先进入蒸馏器，再由管道输出。每种要素都有独立缓存；缓存空间不足时，炼金炉暂停处理，不会丢失要素。
text.en_US:
This furnace fully decomposes compound essentia into its constituent primal aspects. Open its interface and insert material and fuel to smelt items and decompose their aspects.
Essentia can also enter from below through tubes or a container without fuel. Stack up to five arcane alembics on top and connect tubes to the alembics.
Primal aspects enter the alembics before leaving through tubes. Each aspect has its own buffer; processing pauses when the entire result will not fit.
